page.forecast.help.sections.activeNow.te: The Active now section highlights events closest to today.
Labels show whether an event is exact today, was exact recently, or will become exact soon.
This gives you a quick overview of the current period.
page.forecast.help.sections.biwheel.text: The double chart shows the natal chart together with transits, progressions, or directions.
Use the legend to turn individual layers on or off.
Settings let you adjust orientation and point size.
Expand the aspect and ingress tables to see the details.
page.forecast.help.sections.principle.te: Choose a forecast method, period, and location, then click Calculate. Results are available as a timeline, table, double chart, and solar return.
page.forecast.help.sections.solar.text: The solar return view shows the return chart, local and UTC times, and display settings. Use it to explore the themes of the year.
page.forecast.help.sections.solar.title: Solar return
page.forecast.help.sections.table.text: Sort and filter the table by type, aspect, orb, or search text to find the events you need.
page.forecast.help.sections.table.title: Event table
page.forecast.help.sections.timeline.tex: The timeline shows events in chronological order.
Each entry includes the event type, date, and key details of the aspect or ingress.
Use the step and playback controls to move through the period gradually.
Hover over an entry to see more details.
The counter above shows how many events are displayed out of the full period.
If no events appear, check the date range and filters.
page.forecast.help.sections.tips.item1: Start with a period of one to three months to keep the view manageable.
page.forecast.help.sections.tips.item2: Use a maximum orb of 2–3.5 degrees to narrow the results.
page.forecast.help.sections.tips.item3: Compare the timeline and double chart to check an event's context.
page.forecast.help.sections.tips.item4: After filtering, open the forecast chat to ask questions about the events you found.
page.forecast.help.sections.tips.title: Practical tips
